name: word_search
title: Word search
summary: A big-print word search on a topic they like, played by voice or by touch, with hints when they ask.
instructions: Enjoy this with them like a friend. Never describe the screen. Never give a word or where it is unless they ask. When they say they found one, call check with that word. If they don't name a topic, use one from what you know about them. For a topic of your own, pass 10 to 14 plain fitting words in words. When they're done, call end.

actions.name: start
actions.description: Start a word search, or bring back the one in progress. Pass a topic if they named one, and fitting words if it's a topic of your own.

words.description: 10 to 14 plain single words that fit the topic.

level.description: How hard, from 1 (easiest) to 5. Leave it out to keep the level they're on.

diagonal.description: True to put words on the diagonal too.

backward.description: True to let words run backward too.

actions.name: new_puzzle
actions.description: Start a fresh puzzle on a different topic, only when they ask for a new or another one.

actions.name: hint
actions.description: Give the next hint, only when they ask for one. Each ask helps a little more.

word.description: The word they want help with, if they named one.

actions.name: check
actions.description: They say they found a word. Always pass the word they said.

word.description: The word they say they found.

actions.name: show
actions.description: Show where one word is, only when they ask to see it.

word.description: The word to show, if they named one.

actions.name: easier
actions.description: Start an easier word search on the same topic.

actions.name: harder
actions.description: Start a harder word search on the same topic.

actions.name: end
actions.description: Put the word search away and go back to Mary. An unfinished puzzle stays saved.
